meta.note: Delivery charges are real PSEG-LI 2026 residential figures. Power Supply Charge (PSC) fluctuates monthly with the market; we fix a demo 'published rate' below and apply the tariff's published percentages. Peak = 3-7 PM weekdays; Super Off-Peak = 10 PM-6 AM daily. Seasons: summer = Jun-Sep, winter = Oct-May.

net_metering.note: Full-retail-style net metering approximation for the simulator. Customer Benefit Contribution applies to net-meter customers connecting on/after 2022-01-01.

tariffs.name: Residential, General Use (Flat)
tariffs.description: Flat rate for general residential use (lights, appliances, water heating; not space heating). Same price all day, tiered by monthly kWh in summer.

tariffs.name: Residential, Time-of-Day, Off-Peak (Standard)
tariffs.description: Standard residential rate. Higher price during 3-7 PM weekday peak, lower the rest of the time. Rewards shifting use out of the late-afternoon peak.

tariffs.name: Residential, Time-of-Day, Super Off-Peak (EV)
tariffs.description: Time-of-Day rate with a deep overnight (10 PM-6 AM) Super Off-Peak discount, intended for electric vehicle charging.
